strategic_qas.question: What software development services does MOMO IT Technologies provide in Kadapa?
strategic_qas.answer: MOMO IT Technologies provides end-to-end software engineering including custom Web & SaaS applications (Next.js 15, React 19), cross-platform mobile app development (Google Flutter for iOS & Android), custom business ERP & billing software, enterprise QA automation testing (Selenium 4), and cloud solutions. We are located at 4/106, Chowdeswari Temple Lane, Krishnapuram, Kadapa.

strategic_qas.question: Can you build custom billing and inventory software for shops and businesses in Kadapa?
strategic_qas.answer: Yes! We build custom ERP, POS, and billing software tailored to retail stores, wholesalers, cloud kitchens, and service providers. Our systems feature instant GST invoicing, automated customer WhatsApp receipts, stock tracking, and mobile owner dashboards.

strategic_qas.question: How can I get a quote or discuss a new website or app project?
strategic_qas.answer: You can call or WhatsApp our team directly at +91 86398 31132, visit our website at www.momoittechnologies.com, or walk into our Kadapa office at Krishnapuram (Mon-Sat, 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM) for an in-person discovery consultation.

strategic_qas.question: Do you provide software testing and QA automation services for external companies?
strategic_qas.answer: Yes. We offer enterprise QA & test automation services using Selenium 4, Playwright, Cucumber BDD, and TestNG to ensure zero-defect releases for web and mobile products.

strategic_qas.question: Does MOMO IT Technologies also offer IT training and internships in Kadapa?
strategic_qas.answer: Yes. Through MOMO Academy, our in-house engineers conduct specialized, job-oriented career training in Automation Testing, Java, and Full-Stack Development with verified course certificates and live client project internships.
